title: Ensure 'Turn off Autoplay' is set to 'Enabled: All drives'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\AutoPlay Policies\Turn off Autoplay to 'Enabled: All drives'
reason: AutoPlay can be used by malicious software to execute payload automatically from removable media. Disabling AutoPlay on all drives mitigates this risk.

title: Ensure 'Disallow Autoplay for non-volume devices' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\AutoPlay Policies\Disallow Autoplay for non-volume devices to 'Enabled'
reason: Prevents AutoPlay from executing on MTP devices like cameras or phones which could contain malicious code.
